meaning:
παρ-εισ-δύω
(also -δύνω),
to slip in secretly, steal in: παρεισεδύησαν (vulgar aor.; pass. for act., El., § 19, 2), Ju 4 (cf. also MM, xix).†
(AS)
glosses: have crept in among you unnoticed—ungodly ones

renderings.bsb: have crept in among you unnoticed—ungodly ones

elsewhere.note: For there are certain men who crept in secretly, even those who were long ago written about for this condemnation: ungodly men, turning the grace of our God…
